craft_notes: Sthāyin: recognition — seeing, noting, knowing. Rows: triple act then freedom. Read aloud: rising liberation.

lines: So seeing all time's road in breath-rise alone,
and the sundry countless pourings and in-pullings, marking them there,
by self alone his lordship knowing — freed alone he comes to be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam akhilaṃ kālādhvānaṃ prāṇodaya eva paśyan sṛṣṭisaṃhārāṃś ca vicitrān niḥsaṃkhyān tatraiva ākalayan ātmana eva pārameśvaryaṃ pratyabhijānan mukta eva bhavati iti
